🔐 Security

    
PIN lock, session management, and admin audit log.


    
    

      
🔢 Quick PIN Lock

      

        Set a 4-digit PIN for fast unlock when the screen locks from inactivity.
        More convenient than typing your full password each time.
      

      

      

        

          

        

          

      

      

      

        
        
      

    


    
    

      
⏱ Session & Lock Info

      

        
🔒 Password hashing: PBKDF2 + SHA-256 · 100,000 iterations

        
⏰ Session timeout: 8 hours (auto-logout)

        
🔐 Idle lock: Configurable in Store Settings

        
🔑 Field encryption: AES-GCM (sensitive data)

      

      

        
      

    


    
    

      

        
📋 Admin Audit Log

        

          
          
        

      

      
Last 200 events · Auto-deleted after 30 days.

Connect your Anthropic API Key

            Your key is stored only on this device — never sent anywhere except the AI provider.

🛡 Data Protection & Backup

      


      
      

        
📥 Download Backup

        

          Saves a .json file of all your store data — products, transactions, expenses, GCash logs, users, and settings.
          Use this file to restore your data or transfer to another device.
        

        
        

      


      

        
        

          
          

            
            
          


          
          

            

              Load a .json backup file you downloaded from this system.

              Use Replace All to fully restore, or Smart Merge to combine data from two devices.
            

            
⏱ Conflict rule: Newer timestamp wins automatically.

            

            

              
            

            

              
              

                
                
              

            

            

            

              
              
            

            

          


          
          

            

              📡 Sync Management tracks an event queue for future cloud sync (Firebase/Supabase).
              It is separate from backup restore — restore loads a .json file while sync pushes/pulls live changes to/from a cloud provider.
              Currently: offline / no cloud provider connected.

💾 Storage Info

          
Where is your data?
Saved in your browser's IndexedDB — on this device only.

          

            
🔄
Survives page refresh
IndexedDB data persists across page refreshes and browser restarts.

            
🚫
Incognito / Private mode
Data is lost when tab closes. Always use regular browser.

            
🧹
Clearing browser data
Clears ALL POS data including IndexedDB. Always download a backup first before clearing.

          

          

        




        
        

          

            ⚠️
            
Danger Zone

          

          

            Factory reset permanently and irreversibly deletes all products, transactions, expenses, users, GCash logs, and settings.
            


            Download a backup first before doing this.

🗑 Factory Reset

    
This will permanently delete ALL store data. This cannot be undone.

    

      Will be deleted: all products, transactions, expenses, GCash logs, users (except default admin), inventory log, and all settings.

Step 2Type RESET to confirm
